title: The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: A Study of Trajectory Deletion in Software Engineering Agents
title_zh: 遗忘的隐性代价：软件工程智能体中轨迹删除的研究

paragraphs.en: 大规模实证表明软件工程智能体可容忍大幅轨迹删除，但在缓存感知定价下缩减轨迹反而不省钱。 Software engineering agents resend their entire trajectory to an LLM at every turn, motivating online trajectory reduction. Prior work shows that randomly deleting 75% of tokens in old turns may preserve agent effectiveness, but it remains unclear why, how agents compensate for missing content, and whether it actually reduces costs. This paper presents an empirical study of 42 trajectory-reduction configurations, focusing on effectiveness, agent behavior, and cost. We systematically explore deleting content from old turns by varying the scope, granularity, amount, and timing of deletion across 9,400 runs with two state-of-the-art agents on SWE-bench Verified. We find deleting large amounts of trajectory content (e.g., up to 100% of reasoning text) can preserve overall effectiveness. Importantly, such deletion must be applied with a delay, as immediate deletion tends to significantly degrade effectiveness. Agents often compensate for deleted content by re-fetching it, increasing both the number of turns taken and the input/output tokens. Whether trajectory reduction reduces costs depends on the pricing model: Under a flat pricing model, estimated costs fall in 26 of 42 evaluations. Surprisingly, under a caching-aware pricing model, zero evaluations yield lower costs, since reducing the trajectory breaks the cached prefix billed at a lower rate. Our findings have three implications: First, token counts alone are misleading; trajectory reduction techniques must consider overall costs under a realistic pricing model. Second, analyzing trajectories is crucial to understand agent behavior, as end-to-end effectiveness hides differences such as excessive re-fetching. Finally, these results highlight the need for future work on memory management to reduce costs without sacrificing effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模实证表明软件工程智能体可容忍大幅轨迹删除，但在缓存感知定价下缩减轨迹反而不省钱。软件工程智能体在每一轮都会将其完整轨迹重新发送给大语言模型，这促使了在线轨迹缩减的研究。 先前的研究表明，随机删除旧轮次中75%的词元可能保持智能体的有效性，但其原因、智能体如何补偿缺失内容，以及这是否真正降低了成本，仍不清楚。 本文对42种轨迹缩减配置进行了实证研究，重点关注有效性、智能体行为和成本。 我们通过改变删除的范围、粒度、数量和时机，系统地探索了从旧轮次中删除内容的方法，在SWE-bench Verified上使用两个最先进的智能体进行了9,400次运行。 我们发现删除大量轨迹内容（例如，多达100%的推理文本）可以保持整体有效性。 重要的是，这种删除必须延迟应用，因为立即删除往往会显著降低有效性。 智能体常常通过重新获取被删除的内容来进行补偿，这增加了采取的轮次数以及输入/输出词元的数量。 轨迹缩减是否能降低成本取决于定价模型：在统一定价模型下，42项评估中有26项的估算成本有所下降。 令人惊讶的是，在缓存感知定价模型下，没有任何一项评估能降低成本，因为缩减轨迹会破坏以较低费率计费的缓存前缀。 我们的发现有三点启示：第一，仅凭词元数量具有误导性；轨迹缩减技术必须考虑在现实定价模型下的总体成本。 第二，分析轨迹对于理解智能体行为至关重要，因为端到端的有效性掩盖了诸如过度重新获取等差异。 最后，这些结果凸显了未来在内存管理方面开展工作的必要性，以便在不牺牲有效性的前提下降低成本。
